Label: crepuscular
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for being active primarily during dawn and dusk.
Editor note: Definition was incorrectly stored in IAO:0000117 in ecocore-edit.owl; corrected here.

Label: nocturnal
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for being active during the hours of darkness.

Label: diurnal
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for being active during the hours of daylight.

Label: migratory
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for participating in long-distance movement of conspecifics, usually on a seasonal basis.
